sections.heading: Switch to a different assigned study
sections.text: Users assigned to more than one study switch between them with the study selector in the top bar. Only studies and sites assigned to the user are listed.

steps.text: Ask the user to select the study name in the top bar and choose the assigned study they need.

stop_conditions.text: If the user sees a study they were not assigned to, stop and escalate as a possible permission configuration issue.
